color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no modification. Pure white page background (#ffffff), near-black text (#050505). Light register confirmed (luminance 255).

type-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Letter-spacing injection at intensity 3 (0.06em). Added --font-letter-spacing-heading: 0.06em to cssVars and applied via CSS to all heading elements. All fonts validated as Google Fonts CDN: Manrope, EB Garamond, Overpass Mono. woff2 @font-face blocks replaced with Google Fonts CDN @import statements.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Duration scaling (slower) at intensity 2, factor ×1.3. All transition durations: 0.3s → 0.39s. Animation durations: 1.2s → 1.56s, 0.75s → 0.975s, 140s → 182s, 0.45s → 0.585s, 5s → 6.5s. Easing curves preserved unchanged.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Container max-width tightened 10% at intensity 1. 1700px → 1530px. Responsive breakpoints and gap values preserved unchanged. Creates a more editorial, contained reading column.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Hero padding emphasis at intensity 2, factor ×1.25. Elements.hero and elements.wrapper scaled up: wrapper paddingTop 49px → 61.25px, paddingRight/Left 100px → 125px; hero marginRight 120.96px → 151.2px, marginBottom 30px → 37.5px, marginLeft 215.047px → 268.809px. All other spacing unchanged.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist A: Hover transition speed, languid direction at intensity 3 (+0.15s). All button hover transitions slowed from 0.4s to 0.55s. Clamped within 0.05s–0.8s range. No color values changed.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist D: Letter spacing on nav links at intensity 3 (0.08em). Added typography.letterSpacing: 0.08em. Font family updated from Space Grotesk to Manrope to align with assembled type system. No color values changed.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C: Material shift — the Visual Identity paragraph rewritten to foreground the tactile sensation of the assembled design: letter-spacing as felt weight of letterforms, paper stock, letterpress register. concept_by_image.md adapted from dark-mode formless-ai source to light-register assembled system. concept_by_video.md generated fresh with three video placements: hero-bg.mp4 (drafting table light), process-ambient.mp4 (paper macro), studio-interior.mp4 (editorial room at rest).

consistencyChecks.colorContrast: PASS — bodyText #050505 (brightness 5) vs pageBackground #ffffff (brightness 255): sufficient contrast. navText #050505 vs transparent navBackground (treated as #ffffff): sufficient contrast.
consistencyChecks.motionInteractionCoherence: PASS — hover transitions 0.55s, motion primary durations 0.975–1.56s. Ratio ~1.77×, well within 5× threshold.
consistencyChecks.navFontAvailability: PASS — nav fontFamily 'Manrope' is present in assembled typography.json cssVars as font-primary.
